raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12's ingest_ts runs from 02:00 to 22:00, while every other batch has a single load time. This points to part of batch 12 being re-delivered late in the day. raw_transactions has 4886 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_id, so the replayed rows were appended a second time and now appear as 18 duplicate POSTED txn_ids in silver, inflating every gold table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
